storage_model: FILE_BACKED_ONLY — nothing is in the live application DB yet

proposed_tables_not_applied.name: campus_competitive_intel
proposed_tables_not_applied.status: PROPOSED — DDL not applied, no migration written
proposed_tables_not_applied.load: upsert one row per campuses[] object, flattening strongest_competitor.{name,domain,type,course_specific}

proposed_tables_not_applied.name: competitive_competitor_registry
proposed_tables_not_applied.grain: one row per unique competitor domain
proposed_tables_not_applied.status: PROPOSED — optional; only needed if UI lists competitors by brand
proposed_tables_not_applied.load: upsert one row per competitor_registry[] object

proposed_tables_not_applied.name: competitive_competitor_campus
proposed_tables_not_applied.grain: one row per competitor x campus (detail drill-down)
proposed_tables_not_applied.status: PROPOSED — optional; import ONLY if a per-campus competitor drill-down is needed
proposed_tables_not_applied.load: not required for the small drawer UI

canonical_key.note: campus_id in the aggregates file IS the live campuses.id UUID — direct join, no name matching needed

do_not_use_for_priority: evidence_confidence (data-quality meta — use to gate weight, not as a score)
priority_rule: Competitor presence is POSITIVE market validation and must NEVER reduce campus attractiveness. CROWDED = proven demand (positive). WHITE_SPACE = first-mover (also positive, different playbook). competition_intensity is segmentation, not a penalty.

field_classification.market_opportunity: DISPLAY ONLY (owned by market-intel, not this session)
field_classification.evidence_confidence: DO NOT USE (meta — gate weight only)
field_classification.university_free_support: DO NOT USE for priority (context only)

ui_drawer_recommendation.guidance: At most ~5 rows in the existing campus drawer. No standalone competitor dashboard. Price + strongest competitor are optional hover/detail, display-only.

join_contracts.name: campus_aggregate
join_contracts.note: After import. Until then read competitive-intel-output/COMPETITIVE_CAMPUS_AGGREGATES.json keyed by campus_id.

join_contracts.name: deduped_competitor
join_contracts.note: domain is the canonical dedup key across all campuses

join_contracts.name: detailed_competitors_on_demand
join_contracts.how: Filter COMPETITOR_INTELLIGENCE.csv (or competitive_competitor_campus after import) WHERE campus_id = <id>; or read campuses[].top_competitor_domains for the short list. Do NOT eager-load detail into the drawer.
join_contracts.note: Detail is only needed for a drill-down, not the small MARKET section.

code_status.db_state: NONE — no table, no view, no migration. 100% file-backed.
code_status.must_import_before_integration: Create campus_competitive_intel (+ optional registry) and load COMPETITIVE_CAMPUS_AGGREGATES.json. This is the single blocker between the frozen files and a queryable dashboard.

integration_readiness: PARTIAL — the data contract is final, frozen, and fully specified, but it exists ONLY in competitive-intel-output/ files. A one-time import (DDL + load COMPETITIVE_CAMPUS_AGGREGATES.json into campus_competitive_intel, keyed campus_id = campuses.id) is required before the live dashboard can query it. No DB object exists yet.
